notes: Search results were used only to identify candidate sources and their stated geographic scope. No search-result price or product details were accepted.

The browser tool could not display any of the 14 robots URLs; the same exact robots URLs were then requested directly over HTTP. A 403 or 404 is recorded as a robots retrieval failure, not as proof that all pages on the host are blocked.
No offer or merchant page was opened. Public access/reuse rights remain unresolved where noted; therefore no offer pages were opened even when robots.txt allowed the public path.
No CAPTCHA, login, API key, private API, hidden endpoint, or app-only product data was accessed.
